verdict.rationale: Datalab is a document-intelligence API platform that offers agent processors (datalab-docs-40) and custom pipeline steps, so letting users attach MCP servers as tools is a plausible capability for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack shows any MCP-client support or a way to plug in external tool servers. The docs cover conversion, extraction, pipelines, webhooks, the SDK and the CLI, but never MCP tool integration.
